questions.question_english: A school Principal notices that male housekeeping staff frequently clean the girls’ washrooms during school hours. According to the guidelines for the safety of girl students, what is the appropriate administrative action?
options_english: Prohibit this practice immediately and deploy only female housekeeping staff for girls’ washrooms.
Allow it, provided the male staff clean quickly.
Instruct the girl students to form volunteer groups to clean and sanitize their own washrooms during break hours
Schedule the cleaning only during the lunch break.
questions.explanation_english: Prohibit this practice immediately and deploy only female housekeeping staff for girls’ washrooms. Deploying male staff to clean female washrooms during operational hours violates privacy standards and child protection protocols. Administrators must immediately prohibit male maintenance personnel from accessing female rest areas and assign dedicated female sanitation workers. Enforcing strict gender-appropriate staffing in private spaces protects student dignity, ensures socio-emotional comfort, and prevents boundary violations on campus.

questions.question_english: Which of the following items is NOT appropriate to be kept in a standard school First-Aid Box?

questions.explanation_english: Prescription antibiotics and strong painkillers Standard first-aid kits must not contain prescription medications, strong analgesics, or oral antibiotics. विद्यालय सुरक्षा में स्थानीय प्राधिकरणों की भूमिका के संबंध में निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
I. स्थानीय अग्निशमन विभाग NOC जारी करता है और अचानक निरीक्षण करता है।
II. स्थानीय यातायात पुलिस विद्यालय खुलने और बंद होने के समय यातायात नियंत्रित करने में सहायता करती है।
III. नागरिक निकाय विद्यालय की सीमा के पास स्थित खतरनाक संरचनाओं को हटाने के लिए जिम्मेदार होते हैं।
IV. निजी विद्यालयों के अंदर संरचनात्मक मरम्मत का खर्च स्थानीय प्राधिकरण वहन करते हैं।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
options_hindi: I, II और IV
I, II और III
II, III और IV
I, III और IV
questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the role of Local Authorities in school safety:
I. Local fire departments provide NOCs and conduct surprise checks.
II. Local traffic police assist in regulating traffic during school opening and closing hours.
III. Civic bodies are responsible for removing hazardous structures adjacent to the school boundary. IV. Local authorities bear the financial cost of structural repairs inside private schools.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II and IV
I, II and III
II, III and IV
I, III and IV
